title: Answer to Question: The Turkish-Russian Summit
text:
Answer to Question

The Turkish-Russian Summit

Question: The Turkish President Erdogan visited Russia on 9/8/2016 while the “aftershocks” of the failed coup attempt in Turkey have not yet ended. So why this haste? Then what is its purpose, especially since representatives of the foreign ministry, the army and the intelligence also visited Russia? Does this visit have a connection with the Syrian crisis? Or is it for the sake of “restoring” the Turkish-Syrian relationship after the crisis of the downing of the Russian aircraft? May Allah reward you with good.

Answer: To know the reasons for the haste and its purpose, we review the following matters:

1- There was talk of the visit before the coup attempt on 15/7/2016, as it had originally been decided that the summit between the two presidents would be held during the G20 summit held in China in September 2016. But the holding of the summit between the two presidents, the Russian Putin and the Turkish Erdogan, was hastened to the month of August because America was concerned to hasten Turkey's entry into the line of the settlement as an effective tool, after the other tools (Iran, Russia... etc.) had failed. The Turkish Foreign Minister announced the bringing forward of the summit between the two presidents and that it might be held during the month of August in Russia (the Interfax agency attributed to the minister, the Turkish Foreign Minister, a statement that the Russian President Vladimir Putin and the Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan might meet during August in Sochi... Al Arabiya Net, 2/7/2016). The subject of the visit had been discussed within the framework of an atmosphere of “reconciliation”, so that Turkey would play a role in solving the Syrian crisis in accordance with American policy. We clarified this in the Answer to Question we issued on 14/7/2016 CE, where we said: (- America wants from the current Turkish role to pressure the Syrian opposition, and strongly, to return it to the Geneva path and the peaceful solution... and to threaten to abandon the Syrian opposition if it refuses to join the negotiating path, by displaying Turkish-Russian cooperation: “The Russian Foreign Minister said: We hope that contacts will be made between the Russian and Turkish armies regarding Syria. Al Arabiya Net 2/7/2016”... and that Turkey no longer opposes the Russian intervention in Syria... And it is not unlikely that Turkey will go beyond political means in its methods of pressure to military means, under the pretext that it is fighting the terrorism of the organisation, which is not separated from or distinguished from the other armed opposition, that is, the same pretext that Russia uses when it bombs the opposition! And the Russian Foreign Minister's statement about the contacts between the Russian and Turkish armies indicates this possibility...), and we added: (- Obama wants to act as his Democratic predecessor Clinton acted, for he exerted every effort in the last year of his rule to bring the Organisation and the Jews together in a decisive negotiated solution of the Palestinian issue, and although he failed in that, he was able to bring Abu Ammar and Ehud Barak together... And now Obama is exerting every effort to bring the opposition and the regime together in a negotiated solution with the regime, so that it may be said that he did a deed to be remembered for him at the end of his rule. The difference between the attempt of Clinton and that of Obama is that the efforts of the former were prominent in front of his agents, but Obama works through his agents and his tools... and his efforts hide behind them! For America in his era shows more reliance on followers: after Iran and its partisans, and after Russia, and in the shadow of the renewal of America's predicament in Syria, America has instructed Erdogan to reconcile with Russia... After the Iranian and Russian interventions reached their predicament in Syria, America is hastening to thrust Turkey alongside Iran and Russia to preserve American influence in Syria and to eliminate the Islamic character of the Syrian revolution... Thus Russia, which bombs Syria night and day, it and Turkey have become cooperating partners for the war on “terrorism” in Syria, and the talk between them takes place in “an extremely friendly atmosphere”, and indeed the Foreign Minister of Russia requests that contacts be made between the Russian and Turkish armies regarding Syria!!...) End of the quotation from our previous answer dated 14/7/2016.

2- It was expected that the Turkish role would begin hastily, but the coup attempt carried out by the Kemalist officers loyal to the English froze the Turkish role and occupied the regime with internal problems. The freezing of this role could have continued until Turkey was done with the aftershocks of the earthquake of the failed coup, as Erdogan said. But what happened at the beginning of the month of August 2016, the campaign of the revolutionaries to break the siege of Aleppo and their success in it to some extent, made America exploit this campaign to hasten the Turkish role, and consequently the visit to Russia, the normalisation of relations with it, and the launch of the American political solution with an effective Turkish role... America wanted this strong campaign to lose its fruit; instead of being the opening of victory, it made it the opening of negotiation. It made it material that Turkey carries to promote the balanced negotiation that Erdogan mentioned, thinking that Turkey can, with its various means, make the parties, during Obama's numbered days, meet for the American negotiated solution, exploiting the balanced negotiation!! (The Turkish President “Recep Tayyip Erdogan” today called for holding a regional meeting for Syria. His statement came during a lengthy interview that the Qatari channel “Al Jazeera” conducted with him, broadcast this evening, Saturday... “Erdogan” added that the situation in Aleppo is sad, but the opposition has restored the balance recently. Al-Souria Net, Al-Khaleej Al-Jadeed 6/8/2016).

And so it was: the visit took place, and this haste of Obama for Erdogan was for the sake of beginning the work of gathering the parties in a new, “fourth” round of negotiations with which Obama would close his era. This round is what the Turkish Foreign Minister pointed to: (Istanbul “Reuters” - The Foreign Minister of Turkey Mevlut Cavusoglu said on Friday that the talks on the future of Syria must be resumed, and called for a fourth round of the Geneva peace talks. Reuters Arabic 5/8/2016)... And so there was the visit and there was the summit...

3- This summit is considered the concluding step of the path of normalising relations between Russia and Turkey after the great crisis that relations between them witnessed after the downing of the Russian fighter. This path of normalisation was staged in a humiliating form for Turkey: in submission to Putin's conditions, Erdogan apologised for the downing of the Russian aircraft on 27/6/2016, and Erdogan immediately took the initiative on 29/6/2016 to call the Russian President in an atmosphere described as friendly, followed by his Foreign Minister, who held a meeting with the Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov on 1/7/2016 in the Russian city of Sochi, the meeting in which the two ministers also discussed a date for the Putin-Erdogan summit in Petersburg; then the Turkish Foreign Minister's hint at the possibility of giving Russia military bases in Turkey to carry out its strikes in Syria. This collapse in Turkey's positions towards the Russian side was not because of Turkey's pain from the economic sanctions that Russia imposed on Ankara; rather it was exclusively because of the depth of the American predicament in Syria, and that America wants to push Turkey too alongside Russia and Iran to settle the Syrian crisis. For all of that, there was the humiliating image of the Turkish concessions before the Russians; that is, it was because of Turkey's attachment to America and its implementation of American policy, and so there was this Turkish rush...

4- Erdogan insisted on completing the visit to Russia, which had been scheduled before the failed coup attempt on 15/7/2016, despite his intense preoccupation with the internal situation in Turkey, his dealing with what he described as the “earthquake” and his fear of what he described as “its aftershocks”, and his request to the masses in Turkey during the huge rally in Istanbul on Sunday 7/8/2016 to remain in the public squares until Wednesday, that is, until after his return from Russia, for fear of new moves by the military loyal to the English; and likewise despite the escalation of the savage Russian crimes in Aleppo... But despite all this, he insisted on holding his meeting with Putin and not postponing it, because of the intensity of his desire to turn the page of the past with Russia, and likewise because of the strength of the American push of Turkey in the Russian direction. Putin hinted at this insistence by saying (“The Turkish President found the opportunity to visit Russia despite the difficult situation in Turkey after the failed coup attempt on the night of 15 and 16 July” Russia Today 9/8/2016).

5- It was clear that the Syrian crisis was the pivotal subject at the Erdogan-Putin summit. The two presidents did not discuss the subject of the Syrian crisis during the talks with the participation of the members of the delegations; rather they postponed the meeting on Syria to the evening, with the participation of the two foreign ministers and representatives of intelligence, to discuss the ways of the Syrian settlement. Putin said, commenting on the awaited meeting: “We will exchange information and we will search for the solution.” The postponement of the meeting concerning Syria to the evening, and keeping the members of the delegations away from it except for the foreign ministry and intelligence, indicates the secrecy and the great importance that the two sides attach to the Syrian subject, and that, after the removal of the previous obstacles, it is the issue of issues for the two sides; and what is required by America is gathering the parties, the regime and the opposition, at the negotiating table as the conclusion of Obama's era!

6- During the summit and after the summit, the Turkish role began to appear effectively:

A- (Istanbul (Reuters) - The Foreign Minister of Turkey Mevlut Cavusoglu said on Friday that the talks on the future of Syria must be resumed, and called for a fourth round of the Geneva peace talks. Reuters Arabic 5/8/2016)

B- (The Turkish President “Recep Tayyip Erdogan” today called for holding a regional meeting for Syria. His statement came during a lengthy interview that the Qatari channel “Al Jazeera” conducted with him, broadcast this evening, Saturday... “Erdogan” added that the situation in Aleppo is sad, but the opposition has restored the balance recently. Al-Souria Net, Al-Khaleej Al-Jadeed 6/8/2016)

C- (For its part, the Russian media agency yesterday quoted the Turkish ambassador to Russia, Umit Yardim, as saying that the government of Turkey believes that the current Syrian leadership can participate in the talks aimed at solving the crisis in Syria.

The TASS news agency attributed to Yardim the statement that Ankara does not oppose the current Syrian leadership playing some role in a process of political transition. Al-Sabah 12/8/2016)

D- As for the Prime Minister, he was the forerunner on the subject of the political solution with the Syrian regime since the beginning of the reconciliation with Russia shortly before the coup. Al Arabiya Net reported on 13/7/2016 under the title: “Surprise... Turkey speaks of 'normalisation' with the Syrian regime”: the Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yildirim stated: (Ankara (Turkey) - Reuters: The Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yildirim said today, Wednesday, that he is confident of the restoration of his country's normal relations with Syria. Al Arabiya Net, 13/7/2016). The BBC likewise reported it: (The Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yildirim said that Turkey seeks to develop good relations with Syria, in the latest stage of its endeavour to improve its relations with its neighbours. BBC Arabic 13/7/2016)

7- Thus Turkey has plunged into the Syrian crisis effectively, but not to support the people of Syria and rescue them from the savagery of Russia and Iran; rather to be with Russia and Iran in a satanic trio that facilitates their crimes for them and helps them in them, in order to implement an American capitulating solution by negotiating with the regime of the tyrant of al-Sham... That summit which brought Putin and Erdogan together is evil, all of it. Its result was that Turkey openly retreated from all that it used to claim of supporting the revolution in Syria; indeed the retreat reached the point that the Foreign Minister of Turkey says that Russia requests “coordinates” in Syria from Turkey, that is, the positions of the revolutionaries which Turkish intelligence has gathered, to direct the Russian strikes at them. And because of that American insistence on giving Russia what it wants, it was decided after the summit that a high-level intelligence delegation from Turkey would travel to Moscow on the day following the summit, that is, immediately.

The Turkish Foreign Minister had stated on 10/8/2016 to the Anadolu agency (that the points of view between his country and Russia are identical on the necessity of a ceasefire in Syria, delivering humanitarian aid and finding a political solution, and that a strong mechanism of cooperation with Moscow in Syria will be built for that purpose, adding that the director of intelligence, a representative of the foreign ministry and another of the Turkish army would discuss these files in Saint Petersburg on the evening of the same day. Al Jazeera Net, 11/8/2016).

What came in the Turkish Foreign Minister's statement (a ceasefire in Syria, delivering humanitarian aid and finding a political solution) is the American position itself, which is likewise what Russia calls for and fights for. And the speed of sending the officials of intelligence, the army and the foreign ministry to Moscow immediately upon Erdogan's departure indicates that Turkey has completed the sides of the Russian-Iranian-Turkish triangle! The Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister had affirmed “that the region needs good relations between his country, Russia and Turkey. Ebrahim Rahimpour called for new cooperation under the formula 'Turkey-Russia-Iran' and affirmed that his country is ready to proceed in this direction.” Al Jazeera Net, 8/8/2016). On Friday 12/8/2016 Javad Zarif, the Foreign Minister of Iran, met in Ankara with the Turkish officials, who affirmed the agreement to intensify the joint efforts with Iran concerning the Syrian crisis. Erdogan received the Iranian minister Javad Zarif in the presidential palace in a closed meeting lasting three hours, after which nothing was announced, which indicates the haste and urgency of the American arrangements to bring Turkey into the Syrian theatre and to help Russia and Iran in implementing the American tasks.

8- From all of that it becomes clear that Turkey has entered forcefully into bringing about the political solution in Syria in the American way, in a haste that draws attention, although Turkey is not yet reassured about its internal conditions after the coup attempt. All of this indicates the intensity of the insistence from Washington, and it appears that Turkey will proceed according to this American plan with Iran and Russia in the following manner:

- Politically: it will appear to the revolutionaries, in a manner leaving no ambiguity, that Turkey has changed its policy and has begun to head towards the Syrian regime, Iran and Russia, and that it calls on the revolutionaries and pressures them to accept the American formula for the solution in Geneva, which is negotiating with the regime and agreeing with it on the future of Syria, and entering a joint government between the revolutionaries and the regime. And likewise pressuring the revolutionaries, under the pretext of humanitarian aspects, to prevent the revolutionaries' siege of the regime's areas in Aleppo, and promoting the negotiating balance on the basis that the revolutionaries have achieved victories in Aleppo, which makes their negotiation from a position of strength, and mixing this with methods of pressure, and then a ceasefire preceding the management of a political process that achieves something of a “victory” for Obama before the end of his era at the end of the month of January of next year. Perhaps this is what the Turkish Prime Minister pointed to with the coming six months in his statement (The Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yildirim said on Friday that extremely important developments are expected in Syria during the coming six months. Yildirim's statements came after a joint press conference that brought together yesterday, Friday, the Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlut Cavusoglu and his Iranian counterpart Mohammad Javad Zarif. In turn, the Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif said that his country is happy with the Russian-Turkish rapprochement, stressing that resolving the dispute with Turkey regarding Syria is possible through intensifying dialogue. He pointed out that the cooperation of Iran and Turkey on Syria will strongly support the chances of a peaceful solution. Al Arabiya.net, 13/8/2016)

- Militarily: under the heading of fighting the State organisation, Turkey will enter the battles in Syria in alliance with Russia, which will soon turn into a joint force to impose the ceasefire. This includes providing all facilities to Russia to bomb the revolutionaries from the “coordinates of the positions” which Russia does not know and which Turkish intelligence possesses, and Turkey may provide military bases to Russia to facilitate its criminal task of slaughtering the Muslims in Syria.

Iran likewise does so, providing bases to Russia to facilitate this aim, and the coordination between these states has actually begun:

(Cavusoglu also said that Turkish aircraft will join the operations against the State organisation, adding: “We will study all the details. We have always invited Russia to joint operations against the organisation.” Al Jazeera Net, 1/8/2016). And naturally, as is Russia's pretext, it includes all those resisting, because their positions are not separated!

Today there came, in a statement issued by the Russian Ministry of Defence: “Long-range bomber aircraft of the type 'Tu-22M3' and bombers of the type 'Su-34' took off on Sunday 16 August from the Iranian Hamadan airport and directed intensive strikes at the positions of the terrorist organisations 'Daesh' and 'Jabhat al-Nusra' in the governorates of Aleppo, Deir ez-Zor and Idlib in Syria”... And at an earlier time, media revealed that bomber aircraft of the type “Tu-22M3” belonging to the Russian air force had arrived at the Iranian Hamadan airport to participate in directing strikes at the positions of the terrorist organisation “Daesh” in Syria. Russia Today 16/8/2016)

9- This is what America is planning to be implemented by its tools in Syria... This is their plotting, “and the plotting of those, it will perish”. For in al-Sham there are men whom neither trade nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allah; they are upon clear insight in their affair, and by the permission of Allah they will not enable those evil ones to make the victories of the revolutionaries a road to negotiations. And by the permission of Allah that trio drowning in its crimes will not succeed, nor will the management of the trio from Washington, in obtaining from the land of al-Sham what they desire. And just as America's previous tools failed, its subsequent tools will fail, by the permission of Allah... The tyrants have learned during the past five years that in al-Sham there are sincere, truthful multitudes whose resolve has not been weakened by the hosts of America, Iran and Russia, and the partisans and followers, nor even by those who forsook those truthful multitudes in the land of al-Sham. And by the permission of Allah they will remain firm, standing, not bending, and so establish the Sharia of Allah, the Rightly Guided Khilafah, sincere to Allah Subhanahu, truthful with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and then purify the lands of Islam of all the enemies of Islam, and Allah will come to them from where they did not reckon: “And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.”

13th Dhul Qi'dah 1437 AH

16/8/2016 CE
